title: The Disk Substructures at High Angular Resolution Project (DSHARP). X. Multiple Rings, a Misaligned Inner Disk, and a Bright Arc in the Disk around the T Tauri star HD 143006
question: What substructures (rings, gaps, arc, inner-disk depletion, misalignment) are present in the HD 143006 disk in 1.25 mm continuum and 12CO, and how do they compare with VLT/SPHERE scattered light?

data.angular_resolution: 46x45 mas continuum beam; 66x49 mas CO beam
data.sensitivity: continuum rms 14.3 uJy/beam; CO rms 1.04 mJy/beam km/s at 0.32 km/s channels

what.value: SPHERE scattered-light image and shadow analysis

evidence.quote: Recent scattered light observations of HD 143006 show multiple brightness asymmetries

what.value: Midplane temperature profile and optically thin continuum

evidence.quote: From the midplane temperature profile ($T_{mid}$) assumed in (cite: rings)

recipe.method: Imaging with DSHARP parameters; CO with robust 0.8 and 20 mas taper

recipe.goal: Fit Keplerian velocity field to CO moment 1
recipe.method: Razor-thin Keplerian disk model around 1.8 Msun star, convolved with beam, compared pixel by pixel to moment 1
key_parameters: Free: i, PA, vsys, x0, y0; inner/outer radius fixed 0.3 and 250 au

recipe.goal: Fit continuum visibilities with ring and arc models
recipe.method: Three radial Gaussian rings plus a 2D Gaussian arc; B40, B64, arc share geometry, B8 separate; 22 free parameters; model Fourier-transformed and sampled at observed uv
assumptions: Arc follows steady-state vortex prescription (Lyra & Lin 2013)

recipe.goal: Estimate inner/outer disk misalignment and compare with SPHERE shadows
recipe.method: Angle between disk normals from fitted i and PA for two near-side configurations; scattering surface height from Min et al. 2017 equations compared with Hp/R
assumptions: Hp smaller than scattering surface by factor ~2-4; Hp/R~0.04 at 18 au from standard temperature profile of Huang et al.

evidence.quote: The RMS noise in the continuum image is 14.3 $\mu$Jy beam$^{-1}$
we find $i = 22.84\degree \pm 0.05\degree$ and PA $= 165.6\degree\pm0.1\degree$ for the inner disk

answer_key.quantity: Ring radii B8, B40, B64, arc
Misalignment angle (same near side / opposite near side)

evidence.loc: 4.3 A misalignment between inner and outer disk
evidence.quote: we find a small misalignment of 8$^\circ$.

not_stated_but_needed: Imaging parameters for continuum (in survey paper Table 4)
Calibration details, CASA version and self-calibration
Exact continuum model initial conditions and any visibility weighting/averaging
How moment 1 map was made (clipping, tool)
Details of the min2017 scattering surface calculation
missing_for_reproduction: Survey paper imaging parameters and calibration
Continuum model priors and initial values
score_reason: Data public and fits well specified but calibration/imaging defer to survey paper and priors/moment-map details missing.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, numeric model fits with stated sampler setups, though inherited imaging details are needed.
